title: Category summary with a cross-check
objective: Fill a summary table with one copied SUMIF formula, total it and show a check message that compares the table total with the list total.
instructions: The sales list is in A1:C13. In F2:F5, use SUMIF to total the Sales (K) for the category in E2:E5, with $ signs on the two list ranges so the same formula can be copied down. In F6, add F2:F5 with SUM. In F7, use IF to compare F6 with the total of the whole sales list (use SUM on C2:C13): show the text "OK" when they are equal and the text "Check categories" when they are not.
hints: In F2 look in the Category column ($B$2:$B$13), match E2, and add the Sales column ($C$2:$C$13). Copy it down to F5.
F6 is =SUM(F2:F5). For the check you need the total of the original list: SUM($C$2:$C$13).
F7 has the pattern =IF(table total = list total, "OK", "Check categories"). Use F6 for the table total and put the texts in double quotes.
